- gen2 r1+r2: E0017/E0018 (no CM on hash-join keys) RETIRED twice: +0.6%, then +3.0% with q14/q16/q18 slower and hidden validation REGRESSED. DEAD.
- gen2 r3: E0019 deliminate selective SEMI: RETIRED. q04 -9.8% (3 runs -8.7/-13/-16.5%) vs a -20.7% threshold; hidden ok, nothing slower. GOOD idea, short of the threshold. The BF was blocked by the CM offset on the deliminated plan.
- gen2 r4: E0020 exact BF through CM offset: RETIRED although q09 was -12.9/-10.2/-11.1% "beyond noise" and hidden ok, because the visible geomean read +0.0% (noise on other templates cancelled it). GOOD idea. It did not reach q04 because the current q04 plan has no CM on the key.
- gen2 r5: DISPATCHED the bundle E0019+E0020. Rationale: E0019's plan compresses the key, so E0020 unlocks the BF there, and q04 + q09 together should clear the geomean rule.
  - If it is retired again on a noisy geomean: the evaluator's geomean noise needs a gain of about -2% or more. Prefer bundles of independently verified gains, or bigger single wins.
  - If q04 is still not helped: check EXPLAIN ANALYZE to see whether the lineitem scan rows dropped (has_cast gate?).
- Claude auto-memory (~/.claude/.../memory) holds results from a PREVIOUS evolve run on this codebase. Treat them as strong measured priors, not landed code.
- .dbe/issues.md: the first 3 issues (contains selectivity, perfect HJ RIGHT, BF through CM hashed) are stale. Ignore them. The "aggregate CM skip q13" issue is DEAD (it depended on E0017). The RIGHT_SEMI join filters issue is part of the bundle.

## Acceptance lessons
- Acceptance needs BOTH: some template faster beyond its noise AND a visible geomean that improves. A single ~10% template win can be cancelled by noise elsewhere. Bundle verified wins.

## q04 analysis
- q04 = EXISTS over lineitem with date-filtered orders. Base plan: RIGHT_DELIM_JOIN + DISTINCT agg + INNER HJ vs DELIM_SCAN + RIGHT_SEMI on IS NOT DISTINCT FROM.
- The scans are cheap (orders ~15ms, lineitem ~70ms wall). The time is in the delim/join machinery and the 37.9M-row probe.
- Delim join conditions are IS NOT DISTINCT FROM, and join filter pushdown skips NDF. E0019 converted NDF to = on non-null columns.

## Key finding: CM on join keys blocks the BF
- physical_hash_join.cpp:1059: BF only if !has_cast && storage_offset.IsNull(). A CM key has both an offset and a cast. Min/max are shifted via JoinFilterValueToStorage (:717).
- Exact BF: TrySetExactBloomFilter (physical_hash_join.cpp:896), BloomFilter::SetExactRange/IsExact (bloom_filter.hpp:37), probe paths in bloom_filter.cpp (~177/229/337), insert in join_hashtable.cpp:743. Files: src/planner/filter/bloom_filter.cpp, src/include/duckdb/planner/filter/bloom_filter.hpp.

## Measurement lessons
- dbe-tool sql: the first 2-3 runs of a query in a process are slow (warm-up). Alternate A/B/A/B.
- Do NOT wrap in count(*): it changes the plan. Use a temp view + `from v`.
- dbe-tool bash: no pipes, no shell variables, no $(...).
- Bench noise is ±10-20% per template on identical code (q19, q08, q03, q14 worst).

## Profile snapshot: q18 666, q13 570, q09 493, q04 272, q05 238, q08 231, q22 201, q03 196, q07 195, q17 193, q19 172, q16 168, q14 167, q02 103. Geomean 239.6.
- q05: lineitem scan with BF 2.03M rows; l_orderkey=o_orderkey HJ 0.32s.
- q13: inner agg on c_custkey 15M → 1.5M groups; orders scan FSST decode.
- q18: second lineitem scan emits 12.1M rows despite a 111-key IN-list (optional zonemap filter).
- Storage: lineitem l_orderkey BitPacking DELTA_FOR; dates are BitPacking; o_orderpriority is Dictionary.

## Dead / exhausted
- CM join-key removal (E0017/E0018), HJ prefetch, agg run-collapse, in-place finalize, FSST heap reuse, dictionary filter, scan filter cost ordering, early HT grow, sparse perfect HJ, bitpacking select, BF on sparse perfect HJ, hashed BF through CM offset: ~0% or worse.
- Large perfect HA: real q13 gain, but the bench flags q18 each time.
- FSST DecompressVector path is not hot (enable_fsst_vectors is off).

## Next candidates
1. (dispatched r5) the E0019+E0020 bundle.
2. Extend the deliminator to ANTI delim joins (NOT EXISTS: q22, q21).
3. DELIM BF gate for IS NOT DISTINCT FROM conds (q17).
4. q18 IN-list optional filter → evaluate per row when the key set is small (q18 is the largest template, 666ms).
5. q08/q07/q05 not analysed yet.

## Codebase facts
- CM: src/optimizer/compressed_materialization.cpp + compressed_materialization/compress_*.cpp. In release, CM on a join fires only if est. build >= 1M rows and join/build ratio <= 8.
- Rule order: src/optimizer/optimizer.cpp (Deliminator runs before the join order optimizer). Scan-filter cardinality: RelationStatisticsHelper::InspectTableFilter.
- Deliminator: src/optimizer/deliminator.cpp (HasSelection ~:112).
- Join filter generation: JoinFilterPushdownOptimizer::GenerateJoinFilters, join-type switch ~233-240.
- Perfect HJ: perfect_hash_join_executor.cpp:74. Perfect HA: plan_aggregate.cpp. FSST: src/storage/compression/fsst.cpp.
- Noise thresholds: q16 ~7.9%, q18 ~5%, q13 ~14%, q09 ~8.6%, q14 ~5.1%; q04 ~20%; q08/q17 ±5-15%.
- Budget is tight (~$4/session): read memory, the ledger tail and the profile head, then dispatch.

issues.title: Bundle: deliminate selective SEMI (E0019) + exact BF through CM offset (E0020)
issues.hypothesis: Each half was retired on its own but measured a real gain. E0019 (deliminate the SEMI delim join, NDF→= on non-null cols, RIGHT_SEMI/ANTI join filters) gave q04 -8.7/-13/-16.5% over 3 runs, with nothing slower and hidden validation ok. Its notes say the BF was blocked because CM compresses the join key in the deliminated plan (FinalizeFilters skips the BF when storage_offset is set or has_cast), so 37.9M lineitem rows still reach the RIGHT_SEMI join instead of ~2.3M. E0020 (exact-bitmap BF through the CM offset) gave q09 -12.9/-10.2/-11.1% (500→450ms), hidden ok, and was retired only on the visible-geomean rule. It did not reach q04 because the CURRENT q04 plan has no CM on the key, but the E0019 plan does. Together: q09 -11% plus q04 at least -10%, likely -20..-30% once the BF cuts the 37.9M-row probe. The geomean gain should then be clearly beyond noise.
issues.plan: Re-apply both diffs as described in the ledger (E0019 and E0020 implementer summaries). (1) src/optimizer/deliminator.cpp: add SelectionIsReplaceableByJoinFilter so a SEMI delim join with one DelimGet and a simple INNER/SEMI equality subquery becomes a plain SEMI join. Switch IS NOT DISTINCT FROM to = when the RHS column is one of the non-null columns the deliminator added IS NOT NULL for. (2) src/optimizer/join_filter_pushdown_optimizer.cpp GenerateJoinFilters: drop RIGHT_SEMI/RIGHT_ANTI from the bail-out. (3) bloom_filter.hpp/.cpp: add a BFTableFilter key_offset (copy, serialize property 203 with a default). Exact-mode Filter, FilterValue and CheckStatistics subtract it modulo 2^64. CheckStatisticsExact checks that the shifted range round-trips, else NO_PRUNING_POSSIBLE. (4) physical_hash_join.cpp FinalizeFilters: when storage_offset is non-null, the type is integral and the filter is on cond 0, call TrySetExactBloomFilter with the RAW min/max and push only if exact; PushBloomFilter sets key_type to the probe storage type and key_offset to the offset. Then check with EXPLAIN ANALYZE that in q04 the lineitem scan output drops from ~37.9M to ~2-3M rows. If it does not, find which gate still blocks it (e.g. has_cast) before benchmarking.
issues.generality: EXISTS/IN subqueries with a selective outer side (common in decision-support SQL). Also any join whose probe key passes through a CM compress projection, which is common when an agg or sort sits below the join. Possible slowdown: deliminated SEMI joins where the outer filter is not selective lose the DISTINCT reduction, though the selectivity gate limits this. The BF auto-disable covers unselective filters.
issues.risk: Medium. Both halves passed hidden validation and correctness checks separately; the new risk is how they interact (the offset BF on a RIGHT_SEMI probe). Compare results against disabled_optimizers='join_filter_pushdown,deliminator'.
